scenarios.title: Trade stocks and ETFs for me
scenarios.systems: Broker capabilities; security master; live quotes; buying power; authorization; order ledger; reconciliation.

capabilities.name: Market and limit orders
capabilities.contract: Validate security, side, size, price constraints and time-in-force against broker support; return provider order ID and actual fills.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Quote expires or limit order remains unfilled.

capabilities.name: Stop and trailing orders
capabilities.contract: Model trigger basis, trail amount/percentage and order after trigger; show broker support and gaps between trigger and execution.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Price gaps through stop; unsupported trailing order.

capabilities.name: Fractional shares
capabilities.contract: Check security/account eligibility, precision and dollar-versus-share sizing; round only within explicit user limits.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Fractional quantity is rejected or residual cash remains.

capabilities.name: Trading sessions
capabilities.contract: Use exchange calendar, timezone, eligible session and order restrictions; distinguish regular, premarket and after-hours liquidity.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Holiday, halt, session ends during submission.

capabilities.name: Modify or cancel
capabilities.contract: Read current order/fills and use broker replacement/cancel semantics; report pending cancellation until acknowledged.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Order fills while cancellation is in flight.

capabilities.name: Approval and receipt
capabilities.contract: Bind approval to account/order/fees and expiry; prevent replay and store receipt, fills and outstanding quantity.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Timeout after submit, partial fill, late approval.

scenarios.title: Tell me how my portfolio is doing
scenarios.systems: Holdings and transaction history; corporate actions; market prices; total-return benchmark; performance engine.

capabilities.name: Daily and monthly returns
capabilities.contract: Calculate portfolio performance from dated valuations and external cash flows; show incomplete price or history coverage.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Deposit makes balance rise without investment profit.

capabilities.name: Since-inception performance
capabilities.contract: Persist opening values and history; distinguish time-weighted performance from money-weighted investor experience.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Missing opening value or ambiguous cash-flow dates.

capabilities.name: Benchmark comparison
capabilities.contract: Align dates, currency and dividend treatment with a sourced S&P 500 total-return series; label missing periods.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Compare dividend-inclusive portfolio to a price-only index.

capabilities.name: Sector breakdown
capabilities.contract: Map securities and fund look-through coverage; expose unclassified holdings rather than assigning invented sectors.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Fund holdings stale or private asset has no sector.

capabilities.name: Allocation breakdown
capabilities.contract: Aggregate asset classes and account ownership shares at a coherent valuation time without duplicate positions.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Same brokerage connected through two aggregators.

capabilities.name: Performance explanation
capabilities.contract: Reconcile contributions, withdrawals, income, fees and price changes to the balance change with source-linked evidence.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Corporate action causes misleading apparent price drop.

scenarios.title: Keep my portfolio balanced
scenarios.systems: Position model; user targets; lot data; drift rules; broker; approval; constraints.

capabilities.name: Target allocation
capabilities.contract: Validate asset identities, target sum and user ownership constraints; version every target change.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Targets sum to 110 percent or an asset is unsupported.

capabilities.name: Drift monitoring
capabilities.contract: Compute actual-versus-target exposure on coherent fresh valuations, including outstanding orders.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Stale price makes apparent drift exceed threshold.

capabilities.name: Trigger scheduling
capabilities.contract: Evaluate scheduled and threshold triggers with dedupe and cooldown; produce one actionable proposal.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Market oscillates repeatedly around the threshold.

capabilities.name: Trade construction
capabilities.contract: Generate feasible buys/sells with fees, lot precision, cash and outstanding orders accounted for.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Partial fill changes remaining rebalance needs.

capabilities.name: Never-sell-at-loss constraints
capabilities.contract: Use selected lots, basis, fees and enforceable order bounds; surface infeasible constraints instead of ignoring them.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Required reduction conflicts with loss restriction.

capabilities.name: Approval and verification
capabilities.contract: Preview turnover/tax implications and gate each order; reconcile final allocation and remaining drift.
capabilities.adversarial_case: User changes targets between approval and execution.

scenarios.title: Handle the tax side of my investing
scenarios.systems: Broker lots; transactions; corporate actions; household activity coverage; versioned tax rules.

capabilities.name: Cost-basis ledger
capabilities.contract: Track lot acquisition, adjustments, reinvestment and transfers; retain unknown basis as unknown.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Transferred holding arrives without lot records.

capabilities.name: Realized gains
capabilities.contract: Match actual sales and lot elections to proceeds, fees and adjusted basis; reconcile broker statements.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Broker applies a different lot selection.

capabilities.name: Holding-period split
capabilities.contract: Classify short/long-term using applicable rules and actual dates; source special-case treatment.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Sale near anniversary or inherited shares.

capabilities.name: Wash-sale flags
capabilities.contract: Evaluate relevant repurchases with explicit account/household coverage and uncertainty.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Unconnected spouse account buys replacement shares.

capabilities.name: Harvest opportunities
capabilities.contract: Surface loss lots, potential benefit assumptions and replacement restrictions as facts for review.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Tax rate unknown or gains insufficient for assumed benefit.

capabilities.name: Corporate actions
capabilities.contract: Adjust quantity and basis through splits, mergers and spin-offs using sourced events.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Reverse split produces cash-in-lieu or missing basis allocation.

scenarios.title: Research any stock or the market for me
scenarios.systems: Official filings; licensed price/news data; analyst source rights; research provenance.

capabilities.name: Company fundamentals
capabilities.contract: Resolve issuer/security and retrieve dated filings, revenue, margins, debt and ratios with reproducible arithmetic.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Ticker collision or fiscal years differ.

capabilities.name: Bull and bear cases
capabilities.contract: Separate sourced facts, management claims, forecasts and inference; include material counterarguments.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Missing data is filled with plausible invented numbers.

capabilities.name: Analyst ratings
capabilities.contract: Show source, date, rating scale, distribution and limitations under available data rights.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Old target is represented as a live consensus.

capabilities.name: Earnings calendar
capabilities.contract: Track announced versus estimated dates and timezone; update reminders when issuer dates change.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Earnings rescheduled after alert creation.

capabilities.name: Market explanation
capabilities.contract: Tie observed price moves to contemporaneous sourced events while labeling uncertain causation.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Several simultaneous events; no established causal evidence.

capabilities.name: Citations and refresh
capabilities.contract: Attach supporting document/time to material claims and correct amended data.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Source unavailable, paywalled or contradicts another source.

scenarios.title: Alert me on prices I care about
scenarios.systems: Security master; licensed quotes; market sessions; event rules; messaging outbox.

capabilities.name: Threshold creation
capabilities.contract: Store exact security, comparison, price/currency and session scope with a rule version.
capabilities.adversarial_case: User says above 100 but currency or security ambiguous.

capabilities.name: Watchlists
capabilities.contract: Persist additions/removals and issuer identity across ticker changes.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Delisted symbol is reused by another company.

capabilities.name: After-hours coverage
capabilities.contract: Label session, quote timestamp and available coverage instead of showing old regular-session data as live.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Provider lacks premarket feed.

capabilities.name: Trigger semantics
capabilities.contract: Define crossing versus continuously-above behavior and rearm rules; evaluate from ordered observations.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Out-of-order quotes or threshold never crossed from below.

capabilities.name: Exactly-one logical alert
capabilities.contract: Uniquely reserve each rule/version/crossing event and dedupe delivery retries.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Two workers receive the same quote event.

capabilities.name: Controls and evidence
capabilities.contract: Support pause, expiry, snooze and reset; show triggering quote and delivery status.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Threshold edited while a notification is queued.

scenarios.title: Copy top investors' trades
scenarios.systems: Official disclosure feeds; filer identity; security mapping; inferred changes; broker approvals.

capabilities.name: Leader identity
capabilities.contract: Resolve each named person/manager to the actual filer and covered account/entity.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Public personality confused with a similarly named fund.

capabilities.name: Disclosure ingestion
capabilities.contract: Preserve original filing, report period, transaction/publication dates and amendments.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Amended filing reverses a previously extracted position.

capabilities.name: Honest interpretation
capabilities.contract: Distinguish disclosed transactions, quarter-end holdings and inferred changes; retain size ranges and missing positions.
capabilities.adversarial_case: A holdings disappearance is misrepresented as a known sale today.

capabilities.name: Copy sizing
capabilities.contract: Construct user-chosen exposure from supported security and caps, using current prices.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Option disclosure cannot map to a supported equity trade.

capabilities.name: Trade proposal
capabilities.contract: Show filing age, changed price, inference and risks; require approval for each trade.
capabilities.adversarial_case: User expects the leader's historic execution price.

capabilities.name: Outcome tracking
capabilities.contract: Record source-to-proposal-to-fill lineage and copied strategy performance separately.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Duplicate filings trigger duplicate copied orders.

scenarios.title: Manage my copy-trading risk
scenarios.systems: Copy strategy attribution; portfolio exposures; risk policies; orders; disclosure freshness.

capabilities.name: Per-leader caps
capabilities.contract: Aggregate actual and reserved exposure assigned to each leader; enforce cap before new orders.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Concurrent proposals each fit individually but exceed combined cap.

capabilities.name: Per-position caps
capabilities.contract: Aggregate shared holdings across leaders and user trades without hiding overlap.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Two leaders both buy the same issuer.

capabilities.name: Stop-loss rules
capabilities.contract: Specify supported order type, trigger and limitations; approval scope includes protective orders.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Gap, trading halt or unsupported stop for fractional shares.

capabilities.name: Pause and resume
capabilities.contract: Pause new proposals/orders according to scope and preserve reconciliation of submitted orders.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Fill arrives after pause and must still be accounted for.

capabilities.name: Leader conflicts
capabilities.contract: Show opposing disclosed/inferred signals with their dates; apply a user-defined conflict policy.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Signals relate to different report periods.

capabilities.name: Staleness and attribution
capabilities.contract: Use transaction/report/publication dates and provenance; never call old disclosures real-time trading.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Missing sale date or confidential holdings omitted.

scenarios.title: Get me into IPOs at the offer price
scenarios.systems: Official issuer filings; participating broker offering feed; eligibility; allocation workflow.

capabilities.name: IPO calendar
capabilities.contract: Track sourced issuer, offering status, estimated range and tentative dates; preserve revisions.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Rumor or withdrawn IPO appears as confirmed.

capabilities.name: Access eligibility
capabilities.contract: Verify participating broker, user account eligibility and offering-specific restrictions.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Connected brokerage does not participate in the offering.

capabilities.name: Window alerts
capabilities.contract: Detect actual indication-of-interest/allocation windows and closing timezone.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Offering opens briefly or timeline changes.

capabilities.name: Allocation request
capabilities.contract: Distinguish indication, confirmed request, allocation and purchase; honor required review steps.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Oversubscribed offering allocates zero shares.

capabilities.name: Offer-price execution
capabilities.contract: Reconcile actual allotted shares, final offering price and account funding.
capabilities.adversarial_case: User mistakes a first-day market order for IPO allocation.

capabilities.name: Restrictions and expectations
capabilities.contract: Display actual flipping/holding restrictions and uncertain allocation; verify named example availability.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Assumed offering or broker access cannot be substantiated.

scenarios.title: Track pre-IPO companies for me
scenarios.systems: Official issuer/SEC filings; entity resolution; fund disclosures; market/NAV data; scam evidence.

capabilities.name: Company identity watches
capabilities.contract: Track exact legal entities and official announcements for named private companies.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Same-name token claims to represent company ownership.

capabilities.name: Filing alerts
capabilities.contract: Detect public S-1/other relevant filings and amendments with accession IDs and dates.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Confidential filing cannot be observed publicly.

capabilities.name: IPO readiness facts
capabilities.contract: Separate filed, effective, priced and trading states from speculation.
capabilities.adversarial_case: News prediction is presented as an announced listing.

capabilities.name: Proxy exposure
capabilities.contract: Read a fund's actual portfolio, valuation dates, dilution and concentration.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Fund has only small or indirect exposure to target company.

capabilities.name: NAV-premium math
capabilities.contract: Compare sourced NAV per share and same-currency market price, showing premium and valuation lag.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Stale private marks produce misleading precision.

capabilities.name: Scam-token triage
capabilities.contract: Verify issuer relationship and rights against authoritative disclosures; block unverified destinations from execution.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Token uses branding but conveys no shares or redemption rights.

scenarios.title: Invest my money automatically
scenarios.systems: Trigger engine; available cash; broker capability; task approvals; mandates/stop controls.

capabilities.name: Recurring buys
capabilities.contract: Create schedule, security/account, sizing and funding rule; issue approval-gated orders at each occurrence.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Holiday or unsupported fractional sizing.

capabilities.name: Round-up investing
capabilities.contract: Use settled eligible purchases, reversals and batch limits; allocate once then create an investment proposal.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Pending charge disappears or purchase is refunded.

capabilities.name: Paycheck allocation
capabilities.contract: Recognize payroll, split deposits and corrections; reserve eligible user-selected amount without doubling triggers.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Salary arrives in two accounts.

capabilities.name: Cash sweep proposals
capabilities.contract: Compute surplus after obligations, protected buffer and pending orders, with complete disclosed coverage.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Apparent surplus is a provisional credit.

capabilities.name: Drift-triggered buys
capabilities.contract: Use user targets, buy-only feasibility and combined exposure caps; avoid duplicate outstanding orders.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Insufficient cash makes target unreachable.

capabilities.name: Kill switch
capabilities.contract: Pause triggers and pending authorizations atomically; retain reconciliation and explain already-submitted orders.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Order fills as stop is requested.

scenarios.title: Manage my subscriptions
scenarios.systems: Bank history; email/contracts; merchant identity; verified workflows; outcome monitoring.

capabilities.name: Recurring discovery
capabilities.contract: Link account-specific repeated charges and contract notices over stated history coverage.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Annual plan cannot be inferred from 90 days alone.

capabilities.name: Cancellation workflow
capabilities.contract: Resolve exact plan and effective terms, obtain approval and use verified provider route.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Wrong household account or MFA challenge.

capabilities.name: Trial conversion guard
capabilities.contract: Use actual conversion deadline and cutoff with timezone; monitor chosen keep/cancel decision.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Provider changes deadline or cancellation fails.

capabilities.name: Price-hike detection
capabilities.contract: Compare comparable bill/plan periods and notices, separating usage, tax and one-time fees.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Usage increases but base rate stays constant.

capabilities.name: Cancellation proof
capabilities.contract: Capture merchant receipt/effective date and subsequent authoritative charge coverage.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Stale feed incorrectly implies no future charge.

capabilities.name: Exceptions and refunds
capabilities.contract: Track legitimate final invoice, renewed charge and refund request independently.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Canceled annual plan is nonrefundable.

scenarios.title: Handle my bills
scenarios.systems: Obligations; authoritative billers; cash forecasts; payment capabilities; authorization/reconciliation.

capabilities.name: Due reminders and pay offers
capabilities.contract: Discover current unpaid invoice/loan and offer supported payment with amount, fees, arrival and buffer.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Historical debit mistaken for current bill.

capabilities.name: Pay-first ordering
capabilities.contract: Rank by consequences, due date, essential services and user priorities; show infeasible cash constraints.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Disputed demand would otherwise outrank essential rent.

capabilities.name: Overdraft protection
capabilities.contract: Forecast designated funding account using fresh available funds and pending obligations; propose permitted top-up.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Transfer arrives after bill cutoff.

capabilities.name: Autopay management
capabilities.contract: Read arrangement and pending charge, set up through supported route and verify activation.
capabilities.adversarial_case: New agent payment duplicates provider autopay.

capabilities.name: Utility spike diagnosis
capabilities.contract: Use statement usage/tariff/period/taxes to explain supported cause.
capabilities.adversarial_case: No usage data exists to substantiate diagnosis.

capabilities.name: Payment application
capabilities.contract: Submit once and reconcile settlement, correct creditor allocation and returns.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Bank debited but payment allocated to wrong loan.

scenarios.title: Negotiate my recurring costs down
scenarios.systems: Contracts/bills; current comparable offers; user negotiation limits; reviewed drafts.

capabilities.name: Internet script
capabilities.contract: Use actual plan, usage, contract and local competitor availability; draft truthful retention request.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Competitor price excludes required fees.

capabilities.name: Insurance script
capabilities.contract: Compare equivalent limits/deductibles and licensed quotes; preserve coverage requirements.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Cheaper quote reduces essential protection.

capabilities.name: Subscription script
capabilities.contract: Use current plan, usage and dated eligible offers; identify commitments and lost features.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Retention offer extends contract or adds an annual prepayment.

capabilities.name: Competitor evidence
capabilities.contract: Store source/date/geography and total cost for every cited alternative.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Expired offer or user ineligible for advertised rate.

capabilities.name: Rent-on-card math
capabilities.contract: Compute processing fee, actual earned rewards, interest risk and net cost with user's terms.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Carry balance wipes out rewards.

capabilities.name: Savings verification
capabilities.contract: Track accepted terms and actual later bills; distinguish offered discount from realized savings.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Promo savings expire sooner than projected.

scenarios.title: Find class-action money I qualify for
scenarios.systems: Official settlement sources; purchase/residence history; eligibility evidence; deadlines.

capabilities.name: Settlement discovery
capabilities.contract: Ingest authentic administrator/court notices and current claim windows.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Paid lead site masquerades as official administrator.

capabilities.name: Life matching
capabilities.contract: Match confirmed product/service/date/location evidence; label probable rather than certain eligibility.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Same merchant but excluded product or purchase period.

capabilities.name: Eligibility assessment
capabilities.contract: Evaluate class definition, exclusions, prior claims and required attestations.
capabilities.adversarial_case: User already claimed elsewhere.

capabilities.name: Deadline tracking
capabilities.contract: Store submission/objection deadlines distinctly with jurisdiction/timezone.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Extension changes previously scheduled reminder.

capabilities.name: Proof guidance
capabilities.contract: List exact required records and accepted alternatives; draft only truthful responses.
capabilities.adversarial_case: User lacks receipt and cannot attest a fabricated purchase.

capabilities.name: Payout estimates
capabilities.contract: Show formula, uncertainty, caps and potential pro-rata dilution; count actual received money separately.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Advertised maximum confused with expected payment.

scenarios.title: Tell me what I'm spending money on
scenarios.systems: Canonical transactions; merchant identity; categorization; corrections; accounting history.

capabilities.name: Auto-categorization
capabilities.contract: Classify with confidence and user overrides; preserve account/currency and original evidence.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Mixed-use merchant or unfamiliar business.

capabilities.name: Transfer exclusion
capabilities.contract: Pair owned-account transfers and card payments to avoid double counting.
capabilities.adversarial_case: AUTOPAY utility or Zelle rent misclassified as a transfer.

capabilities.name: Monthly reporting
capabilities.contract: Reconcile posted expenses, refunds and period coverage to account history.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Refund arrives in a later month.

capabilities.name: Merchant breakdown
capabilities.contract: Group normalized merchant identity while retaining distinguishable plans/accounts.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Two unrelated merchants have similar names.

capabilities.name: Year-over-year comparisons
capabilities.contract: Align periods, history coverage, currency and category definitions.
capabilities.adversarial_case: New account creates artificial spending growth.

capabilities.name: Search and drill-down
capabilities.contract: Return exact contributing transactions and correction history for each total.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Category edit fails to update derived report.

scenarios.title: Build and enforce my budget
scenarios.systems: Real cash/income/obligations; category rules; forecast; alerts; consented controls.

capabilities.name: Budget construction
capabilities.contract: Use observed net income, necessary costs, goals and history coverage; expose assumptions.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Irregular income makes average misleading.

capabilities.name: Category limits
capabilities.contract: Define periods, rollover, ownership and inclusion rules in a versioned budget.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Joint expense counted at full amount for both people.

capabilities.name: Pre-limit warnings
capabilities.contract: Forecast committed and expected spend before threshold, with explainable uncertainty.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Pending charge later disappears.

capabilities.name: Subscription accounting
capabilities.contract: Include subscription charge once in correct category and period.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Subscription appears both as fixed bill and separate expense.

capabilities.name: Enforcement meaning
capabilities.contract: Implement alerts and supported user-authorized controls; disclose inability to block unsupported external purchases.
capabilities.adversarial_case: User assumes budget can decline any bank-card transaction.

capabilities.name: Adjustments and outcomes
capabilities.contract: Apply user changes and refunds consistently; reconcile actual versus planned.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Month-end edit rewrites historical targets without versioning.

scenarios.title: Make sure I survive to payday
scenarios.systems: Account-specific forecast; essential spend; obligations; verified payroll; prioritization.

capabilities.name: Payday identification
capabilities.contract: Identify each reliable income stream and next expected pay date with confidence.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Bonus or transfer mistaken for regular salary.

capabilities.name: Burn-rate model
capabilities.contract: Separate essential/variable costs and seasonality from transfers; disclose missing cash spending.
capabilities.adversarial_case: One unusual month distorts daily burn.

capabilities.name: Bill-versus-paycheck timeline
capabilities.contract: Model unpaid/pending obligations and payroll timing by account.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Bill due today incorrectly advanced to next cycle.

capabilities.name: Shortfall detection
capabilities.contract: Find projected minimum balance and date under stated scenarios.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Delayed paycheck or annual bill not in recent history.

capabilities.name: Payment order
capabilities.contract: Explain essential/deadline/consequence priorities and user constraints without blindly paying disputed debts.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Available cash cannot cover all minimums.

capabilities.name: Recovery plan
capabilities.contract: Offer realistic changes, supported transfers or assistance with effects and approval needs.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Unapproved credit or earnings presented as guaranteed rescue.

scenarios.title: Connect all my money accounts in one place
scenarios.systems: Connection registry; normalized accounts; incremental sync; identity; history/retention.

capabilities.name: Multiple banks
capabilities.contract: Maintain separate connection/item secrets and account identities per institution.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Linking second bank overwrites first token.

capabilities.name: Brokerage aggregation
capabilities.contract: Import holdings, cash, transactions and valuation dates with explicit coverage.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Broker supports read access but not trading.

capabilities.name: Balance normalization
capabilities.contract: Separate available/current cash, liabilities, credit limits and ownership/currency.
capabilities.adversarial_case: String balance concatenates or credit limit counted as wealth.

capabilities.name: Transaction search
capabilities.contract: Index stable transactions across sources with account-aware pending/posted lineage.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Relink changes provider transaction IDs.

capabilities.name: Connection repair
capabilities.contract: Handle revoked consent, MFA, partial outage and unsupported products without substituting data.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Missing token silently falls back to another user's secret.

capabilities.name: Clean disconnect
capabilities.contract: Revoke provider access and stop new sync/actions; retain explicitly permitted history and distinguish account deletion.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Disconnect one institution removes unrelated history.

scenarios.title: Watch my cash flow daily
scenarios.systems: Bank sync; pending/posted matching; income detection; monitor queue; notifications.

capabilities.name: Low-balance alerts
capabilities.contract: Use designated available balance and source age; evaluate protected buffer and near-term obligations.
capabilities.adversarial_case: First returned account is a brokerage or credit account.

capabilities.name: Paycheck landing
capabilities.contract: Match posted payroll against expected stream, amount and split deposits.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Replayed sync sends repeated celebrations.

capabilities.name: Duplicate charges
capabilities.contract: Identify same-account probable duplicates with explanatory evidence and confidence.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Pending authorization and posted charge treated as two charges.

capabilities.name: Pending reconciliation
capabilities.contract: Update pending-to-posted identity and amount without duplicate expenses.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Restaurant tip changes final amount.

capabilities.name: Balance reconciliation
capabilities.contract: Explain holds, transfer timing and covered-through data rather than fabricate a missing transaction.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Provider balance newer than its transaction coverage.

capabilities.name: Daily reliability
capabilities.contract: Run per-user timezone with paging, retries and dedupe; surface stale data clearly.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Worker outage causes missed or repeated alerts.

scenarios.title: Brief me on my money every morning
scenarios.systems: Financial model; due events; notification preferences; outbox; summary provenance.

capabilities.name: Morning schedule
capabilities.contract: Persist user timezone, delivery time and quiet-hour preference; one brief per local day.
capabilities.adversarial_case: DST transition or travel changes device timezone.

capabilities.name: Balance summary
capabilities.contract: Show supported fresh cash/debt/investment balances with timestamps and coverage.
capabilities.adversarial_case: One bank feed fails while others succeed.

capabilities.name: Overnight activity
capabilities.contract: Summarize relevant posted changes since prior successful brief.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Delayed transactions arrive with earlier transaction dates.

capabilities.name: Due and attention queue
capabilities.contract: Include unpaid bills, expiring approvals, failed actions and missing evidence, urgency ranked.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Autopay-covered bill incorrectly prompts another payment.

capabilities.name: Weekly deeper review
capabilities.contract: Reconcile weekly change, goals, opportunities and outstanding tasks using a stable period.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Week crosses month/year boundary.

capabilities.name: Delivery and relevance
capabilities.contract: Track delivery, avoid sensitive household disclosures and support snooze/frequency changes.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Transport retries the same outbound message.

scenarios.title: Alert me to anything unusual
scenarios.systems: Account-aware anomaly/fee detection; prioritization; event registry; messaging preferences.

capabilities.name: Spending anomalies
capabilities.contract: Compare relevant personal baseline with explainable amount/frequency/merchant signals.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Travel or known large purchase produces excessive alarms.

capabilities.name: Fees and spikes
capabilities.contract: Recognize posted fees and comparable recurring-price changes with evidence.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Refunded fee still counted as a new loss.

capabilities.name: Urgency ranking
capabilities.contract: Combine deadline, potential loss, confidence and user context with explicit escalation rules.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Low-confidence signal crowds out imminent payment failure.

capabilities.name: Quiet hours
capabilities.contract: Use user's stored timezone and chosen urgent exceptions.
capabilities.adversarial_case: UTC scheduling sends nonurgent alert at 3 AM.

capabilities.name: Snooze lifecycle
capabilities.contract: Store event/rule scope and expiration; resurface only if still relevant or materially changed.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Snoozed price alert reappears on every sync.

capabilities.name: Dedupe and correction
capabilities.contract: Uniquely identify findings and update/retract changed evidence; delivery retries preserve one logical alert.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Two workers detect same fee or later reversal.

scenarios.title: Find me ways to make extra money
scenarios.systems: Verified offer catalog; eligibility; evidence; dependency planner; payout tracking.

capabilities.name: Catalog trust
capabilities.contract: Require source, last verification, geography, payout mode and expiry; remove unsupported promises.

capabilities.name: Realistic fills
capabilities.contract: Specify bid/ask, slippage, liquidity, fees, session and fill assumptions; avoid using future prices.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Order placed after candle still fills at earlier low.

capabilities.name: Strategy accounting
capabilities.contract: Track cash, holdings, realized/unrealized returns, costs and corporate actions.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Split creates fictitious gain or negative position.

capabilities.name: Practice review
capabilities.contract: Compare benchmark/risk under the declared model; show simulation limitations.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Optimistic fake fills represented as expected real performance.

capabilities.name: Graduation to live
capabilities.contract: Require new account linkage, permissions and fresh trade approvals; never replay historical paper orders.
capabilities.adversarial_case: One click unintentionally submits all simulated positions.

scenarios.title: Run my yearly financial review
scenarios.systems: Covered-year accounting; investments; rules/documents; policies; goals; outcomes.

capabilities.name: Spending review
capabilities.contract: Reconcile covered-year income/spending/fees with major changes and missing history.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Only 90 days available but report called full year.

capabilities.name: Investing review
capabilities.contract: Use deposit-adjusted returns, allocation, fees and tax lots with coverage.
capabilities.adversarial_case: New brokerage balance mistaken for investment gain.

capabilities.name: Tax review
capabilities.contract: Summarize source-backed paid/withheld/estimated amounts, documents and outstanding deadlines.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Prior-year facts silently used for new-year plan.

capabilities.name: Insurance review
capabilities.contract: Check confirmed policies, exposures, renewal and comparable options.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Unknown coverage declared absent.

capabilities.name: Goals and outcomes
capabilities.contract: Compare original/versioned goals to actual contributions and verified saved/recovered money.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Potential savings counted as achieved.

capabilities.name: Next-year plan
capabilities.contract: Create prioritized achievable milestones and reviewed workflow proposals.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Annual review enables autonomous actions without consent.

scenarios.title: Fight unfair charges for me
scenarios.systems: Bank/merchant evidence; dispute deadlines; draft templates; user-sent boundary.

capabilities.name: Charge identification
capabilities.contract: Identify exact account, posted charge and alleged issue with user confirmation.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Legitimate repeated purchase or pending hold misidentified.

capabilities.name: Evidence assembly
capabilities.contract: Collect receipts, cancellation/delivery records, communications and dates without fabrication.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Missing proof substituted by invented narrative.

capabilities.name: Dispute drafts
capabilities.contract: Prepare factual issuer/merchant-specific request with source references and placeholders.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Wrong account or deadline appears in letter.

capabilities.name: Fee-waiver requests
capabilities.contract: Reference actual fee and truthful circumstances, with no guaranteed success.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Draft claims bank promised reversal without evidence.

capabilities.name: User-send boundary
capabilities.contract: Provide reviewed drafts and official routes; do not send/file in user's name under this scenario.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Generic communications tool sends automatically.

capabilities.name: Outcome tracking
capabilities.contract: Track user-reported submission separately from official decision and allocated credit.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Provisional credit treated as final money recovered.

scenarios.title: Manage my dividend income
scenarios.systems: Corporate announcements; holdings/lots; broker payments/DRIP; tax/currency data.

capabilities.name: Dividend payouts
capabilities.contract: Reconcile actual gross/net dividends, withholding and account/source IDs.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Reinvested dividend counted as both cash and shares twice.

capabilities.name: Upcoming dates
capabilities.contract: Track declared ex-date, record/pay dates and eligibility with source/time.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Estimated dividend presented as declared.

capabilities.name: Entitlement calculation
capabilities.contract: Use eligible quantity and corporate action/settlement rules with confidence.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Holding acquired too late for dividend entitlement.

capabilities.name: Yield on cost
capabilities.contract: Compute under explicit lot/adjusted-basis convention and distinguish from current yield.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Transferred holding has unknown cost basis.

capabilities.name: DRIP controls
capabilities.contract: Read broker/account/security support and preview elected setting; require authorization for changes.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Broker does not allow per-security DRIP toggle.

capabilities.name: Payment exceptions
capabilities.contract: Handle late/canceled/changed payouts, foreign currency and corrections.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Expected payment misses date but agent declares received.

scenarios.title: Find money owed to me
scenarios.systems: Official property searches; residence/name history; referral/rewards ledgers; credit allocation.

capabilities.name: State-property discovery
capabilities.contract: Search relevant official sources using user-approved identity/residence history.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Same-name property belongs to another person.

capabilities.name: Eligibility and proof
capabilities.contract: Prepare source-specific claim evidence and identify required user attestations.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Ownership inferred from name alone.

capabilities.name: Referral tracking
capabilities.contract: Use unique qualifying paid-user events and actual reward terms.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Duplicate Stripe event creates repeated credit.

capabilities.name: Unredeemed cashback
capabilities.contract: Read reward availability/expiry and supported redemption methods.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Pending rewards treated as withdrawable cash.

capabilities.name: Recovery follow-through
capabilities.contract: Track submitted/pending/approved/paid states and source-linked receipts.
capabilities.adversarial_case: Sent application counted as recovered money.

capabilities.name: Exclusive outcome accounting
capabilities.contract: Allocate each credit once and distinguish cash, account credit and noncash value.
capabilities.adversarial_case: One refund completes two recovery requests.
